source.note: Aldar's American schools follow the Massachusetts State Standards (Common Core for ELA & Math, NGSS for Science), with Advanced Placement at high school and the American High School Diploma. Commercial textbooks (McGraw-Hill, Savvas/Pearson, HMH) are copyrighted and are NOT bundled here. The links below point to the official free standards and to genuinely free / openly-licensed resources (OpenStax and CK-12 are CC-licensed and may be added as a textbook.pdf). To add a book, drop a licensed or open-licensed copy into this folder.
